sn46.57:1.1: bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttassa bojjhaṅgachaṭṭhakaṃ chaṭṭhaṃ. bojjhaṅgassa ānāpānādipeyyālo sattamo sāvatthīnidānaṃ.
sn46.57:1.2: aṭṭhikasaññā bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā.

sn46.57:1.4: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu aṭṭhikasaññāsahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ …pe…
